badge: PHASE 1 OF $2B MIDTOWN PARK · SALES LAUNCHED
description: Midtown Park Residences By Proper is the inaugural tower in a five-acre, $2 billion master plan between Wynwood, the Design District, and Edgewater. Arquitectonica's 28-story tower delivers 288 Proper-branded residences, studios through penthouses, with Meyer Davis interiors and 40,000 square feet of amenities on the 7th-floor Proper Floor.
editorialLine: Proper arrives in Midtown. Culture, design, and five acres of urbanism in between.

stats.label: Entry pricing, below branded-residence tier
stats.note: Starting in the low $600,000s for a branded product. Comparable Edgewater and Design District branded towers start at $1M+. The master plan is the long-duration value driver.

stats.label: Residences, Phase 1 of 924
stats.note: Studio through 3BR plus Private Collection penthouses with 4-5BR layouts, 20-ft ceilings, rooftop gardens, and private pools. Phase 1 is 31% of the eventual 924-unit master plan.

stats.label: Master plan, $2B buildout
stats.note: 1.17M sq ft total: two 28-story towers, two 17-story towers, 60,000 sq ft office, over 100,000 sq ft retail, public plazas, landscaped paseos, and a padel and racquet club.

stats.label: Delivery, UDRB approved Oct 2025
stats.note: City of Miami Urban Development Review Board approval secured October 2025. Construction timeline tracks toward 2028 delivery. Shelborne By Proper already reopened in South Beach.

signals.title: A master plan that links three districts
signals.body: The full redevelopment links Midtown, Wynwood, and the Design District with major office, retail, and public-space programming — a long-duration value driver as the district builds out around Phase 1.

signals.title: Proper Hospitality, second branded residence globally
signals.body: Midtown Park is Proper Hospitality's second branded residence globally. Owners receive Culture Concierge programming, preferred rates across Proper properties, and access to the Shelborne By Proper Beach Club on Miami Beach.

signals.title: Arquitectonica, Meyer Davis Studio, Naturalficial
signals.body: Arquitectonica leads architecture, Meyer Davis Studio designs interiors, and Naturalficial leads landscape. The project pairs institutional design pedigree with a layered public-realm program across plazas, greenery, and integrated art.

signals.title: 40,000 sq ft amenities on the Proper Floor
signals.body: The Proper Floor consolidates 40,000 square feet of lifestyle programming, including pool, wellness, fitness, sport, and social spaces. The package is designed as a full-day resident ecosystem rather than a standard tower amenity deck.

signals.title: ULTRA Padel and a planned racquet club
signals.body: ULTRA Padel partners on a padel and racquet club planned within the Midtown Park master plan. It positions Midtown Park around one of luxury housing's fastest-growing amenity categories.

signals.title: Midtown, Wynwood, and Design District within walking distance
signals.body: 3055 North Miami Avenue sits at the seam between Midtown, Wynwood, and the Design District. The location offers walkable daily retail and short-hop access to Miami's highest-velocity cultural and luxury corridors.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Midtown Park Residences is a value play on Miami's branded-residence category, with entry from the low $600,000s for a Proper-branded, Arquitectonica and Meyer Davis tower below the $1M+ Edgewater and Design District floor. The $2B, five-acre master plan will anchor Midtown as a walkable district between Wynwood and the Design District, capped by a padel and racquet club operated by ULTRA Padel. Phase 1 buyers capture pricing before full buildout delivers and before Proper expands its U.S. residential footprint beyond two properties.
investmentIntelligence.footnote: HOA: TBD · Rental policy: TBD · Delivery: est. 2028

residenceContent:
Midtown Park Residences By Proper is the inaugural tower within Midtown Park, a five-acre mixed-use master plan connecting Midtown Miami to Wynwood, the Design District, and Edgewater. Arquitectonica's 28-story tower delivers 288 Proper-branded residences. Interiors by Meyer Davis Studio carry Proper Hospitality's design language from the 5,000-square-foot art-filled lobby through 40,000 square feet of amenities on the 7th-floor Proper Floor.

Lobby5,000 SF
Proper Floor40,000 SF
Penthouses20-ft living rooms
Beach club10 min to Shelborne

The residences

  • Studios through three-bedrooms on typical floors
  • Private Collection penthouses: four- and five-bedroom homes with double-height 20-foot corner living rooms, rooftop terraces, private gardens, and pools

Finishes

  • Kitchens: Italian cabinetry, imported quartz, Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, and Hansgrohe faucets
  • Primary baths: Meyer Davis-curated Jade ceramic walls and Hansgrohe brass fixtures

The Proper Floor

  • Heated 60-foot pool anchored by a Hernán Marina sculpture
  • Adult spa pool and pickleball court
  • 3,000-square-foot fitness center with Pilates room
  • Spa with steam room and sauna
  • Virtual golf and screening room
  • Communal vegetable garden designed by Naturalficial
  • East Lounge with chef's kitchen, plus a dedicated event lounge

Owner privileges

  • Proper Culture Concierge program
  • Preferred rates across the Proper Hospitality portfolio
  • Shelborne By Proper Beach Club on South Beach, a 10-minute drive across the causeway

At master-plan buildout

This tower is Phase 1 (288 units). The full Midtown Park district at completion:

All phases924 units
Office60,000 SF
Retail100,000+ SF
Racquet clubULTRA Padel
